build_text_processor: build a TextProcessor that tokenizes text strings using a pretrained BERT tokenizer
build_video_processor: build a VideoProcessor that loads numpy video feature tokens from .npy files
build_aligner: build an Aligner that aligns video and text features into model-ready tensor dicts
build_mm_attention_mask: build a 2D multimodal attention mask for text generation, video generation, or joint tasks
build_meta_processor: build a MetaProcessor subclass that loads dataset metadata like video IDs and captions
